diagnostic_reason: A classification of this station's own criteria. It runs no model and reads no price; it reads the records and a hand-assigned table kept in the script beside it.

rows.name: B21-1  the class index is nonzero on every leg-year
rows.why: the index is log((P1+D)/(P1+0.9D)); with D>0 and P1>0 it cannot be zero, so 'non-zero on every leg-year' is fixed before the data is read

rows.name: B21-13  the twelve-month edge reproduces the first arm's shape at a statutory gap of 0.25: below one and monotone down in the yield
rows.why: the twelve-month edge, the same algebra at a gap of 0.25

rows.name: B21-14  the capital-gains edge takes the opposite shape the same algebra predicts: above one and monotone up in the gain
rows.why: the capital-gains edge, the same algebra with the sign of one variable turned

rows.name: B21-15  neither statutory index is zero anywhere
rows.why: 'neither statutory index is zero anywhere' is the same forced non-zero as B21-1

rows.name: B21-16  on the loss branch the statute reverses the index's sign, and the shape mirrors: below one and monotone down in the size
rows.why: the loss branch of the same algebra

rows.name: B21-2 A leg  the gap sits under the second order term and falls monotonically in the yield
rows.why: a Taylor remainder in the yield, checked against its own closed form

rows.name: B21-2 H leg  the gap sits under the second order term and falls monotonically in the yield
rows.why: same

rows.name: B21-10  the stock-level term is not degenerate
rows.why: a degeneracy guard

rows.name: B21-17  gate two, first stage: the instrument separates the statutory band without borrowing anything
rows.why: gate two, first stage: an arithmetic on the standard error

rows.name: B21-4  the individual term is not degenerate
rows.why: a degeneracy guard on the individual term

rows.name: B21-7  the estimated stock-level term is not degenerate
rows.why: a degeneracy guard on the estimated stock-level term

rows.name: B21-9  four instruments, three of which cannot return a negative, agree on the ordering of the legs
rows.why: four range estimators against each other; it failed

rows.name: B21-11  the stock-level term is bounded below exactly, with no estimator in the chain
rows.why: a published tick gives an exact lower bound, no estimator in the chain

rows.name: B21-21  every cell of the two-by-two carries a centre
rows.why: every cell of the two-by-two carries a centre

rows.name: B21-20  VOID  the direction this asked for was never implied by the statute, which admits 0, 10 and 20 per cent holders at once
rows.why: withdrawn: the direction it asked for was never implied by the statute

rows.name: B21-12  the tick binds where the floor is large, so the floor's dispersion is a reading and not only a bound
rows.why: cross-stock dispersion of the floor, a reading rather than a bound

rows.name: B21-18  the pooled difference falls inside the band the statute declares
rows.why: an effect size against a band the statute declares; it could have landed outside

rows.name: B21-19  the within-company difference falls in the same band, with the company cancelled
rows.why: the same difference within company, the company cancelled

rows.name: B21-22  the taxed leg's move across the date, read in three states because a sign test on an estimator has no zero width
rows.why: the taxed leg's move across the date, read in three states

rows.name: B21-23  the untaxed leg of the same companies does not move with it, which is the placebo
rows.why: the untaxed leg of the same companies, the placebo

rows.name: B21-24  the trade the statute penalises leaves no volume signature to remove: no cell's pre-ex window stands above its own baseline by more than the H leg does in both eras alike
rows.why: no volume signature to remove; undecidable

rows.name: B21-25  the implied rate stays inside the mixture the statute allows, 0 to 25 per cent, on both sides of the date
rows.why: the implied rate inside 0 to 25 per cent. **The band is the whole statutory support, so almost any reading sits in it**; recorded as world but weak

rows.name: B21-6  PLACEBO, and it fails: currency events do not move the common term, so the common term is not the currency wedge
rows.why: a placebo on currency events; it failed and removed an interpretation of the common term

rows.name: B21-8  the stock-level term against the common one: UNDECIDABLE on daily bars, which is the third state and neither a pass nor a fail
rows.why: stock-level against common term; undecidable at daily resolution
